description: The Onslow Community Resilience Testbed is a virtual testbed of Onslow County, North Carolina, built from publicly available US data so that researchers can design experiments, examine model or system integration and test theories of community resilience. It was published on DesignSafe-CI in 2022 by Seyyed Amin Enderami, Elaina Sutley and Ram Krishna Mazumder. The project holds supporting documents, metadata, algorithms, Python scripts, Jupyter notebooks, datasets and GIS files procured or generated to build the testbed; subject terms name building inventory and social vulnerability. Coverage: Onslow County, North Carolina. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot, project PRJ-3754. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODC-By-1.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the file list and hazard scenarios were not read; the testbed is meant to grow through collaboration, so contents may change. Simulation uses: community resilience modelling that links building inventory, social vulnerability and hazard scenarios. Related records: the IN-CORE platform and the Tomorrow's Cities multi-hazard data.
